      public AddEmployeeController(EmployeeModel model, Runnable on_saved, EmployeesRowDTO existing)
      Creates an employee form controller.
      Parameters:
      model - the employee model used to save and delete employee records
      on_saved - refresh invoked after an employee is saved or deleted
      existing - the employee being edited, or null when adding an employee
